title: § 28-507.9 Compliance with fire code sprinkler requirements for altered buildings on substandard width streets.

blocks.html:
Any habitable apartment in a basement or cellar created or altered pursuant to section 28-507.3 shall be deemed to be an alteration subject to exception 5.1 of section 501.4.3.1 of the New York city fire code.
(L.L. 2024/126, 12/18/2024, eff. 6/16/2025)
